note: Made by web/test/generate/device-checks.ts with test keys made on the spot. The issuer keys below stand in for MOICA's G2 and G3: use them in place of spec/issuers.md for these cases only. Bytes (certificates, CRLs, the mirror's answers) are lowercase hex; moduli and serial numbers are 0x-prefixed lowercase hex without leading zeros (00 ff 01 is 0xff01); certificate times are the 12 digits YYMMDDHHMMSS (UTC) as the certificate writes them; dates are in Taiwan.
